## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences describing the change. -->

## Why

<!-- The motivation — what student problem this solves, what bug it fixes, what was previously broken. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Design system change (touches DESIGN.md or visual tokens)
- [ ] Tooling / infrastructure (CI, build, deploy)

## Design system check

If this PR touches anything visual:

- [ ] I read [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md) before making this change
- [ ] My change uses existing design tokens (no new colors, fonts, or spacing values)
- [ ] **OR** my change introduces new tokens, and I've added a `Decisions Log` entry to DESIGN.md explaining why

## Mobile check

- [ ] I tested this at 360px width (the smallest student phone)
- [ ] **OR** this change doesn't affect visible UI

## Documentation updates

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] PROJECT_HISTORY.md updated (for narrative-worthy changes)
- [ ] TECH_MEMORY.md updated (for architecture decisions)
- [ ] DEFENSE_BRIEF.md updated (for "why X over Y" decisions)
- [ ] No docs needed for this change
